subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should this PR land the Automations feature and related post-merge Skills corrections together once refreshed against current main, or should the Skills follow-ups be split into a narrower change?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well proven, but the protected maintainer label and combined user-facing native scope make acceptance and packaging an owner decision.

options.title: Approve combined scope
options.body: Refresh onto current main, require the queued native and dependency checks to pass, then land the reviewed Automations and Skills follow-up changes together.

options.title: Split Skills follow-ups
options.body: Move the already-merged Skills corrections into a narrow follow-up PR and retain only Automations, cron pagination, and required localization changes here.

options.title: Defer native parity
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open and pause this branch if the current mobile product direction does not justify the new management surface.

recommendation.title: Approve combined scope
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, require the queued native and dependency checks to pass, then land the reviewed Automations and Skills follow-up changes together.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows direct ownership of the linked feature request, this implementation, and the merged native Skills work creating the scope decision.
